limitations: Calibration only on warm fixture in DAMON-disabled guest; not total combined instrumentation overhead
Five Bash realtime boundaries; outer dual clock checked; phase clocks not independently monotonic
Two observations per condition in comparison; descriptive means only, no confidence interval
Initial add native regions can nest and omit work; guest device-wide counters include other guest work and do not measure storage waiting; command wall/CPU precision is 1ms; no instruction counts
Controller minus guest envelope includes control channel and boundaries, not pure network time
All periodic monitoring off; preserve official default and original whole-task metric
Step 025 queue-wait upper bound and KVM setup counts cover both vCPUs over the full capture; zero async setup does not exclude synchronous faults or I/O; cache counters are non-atomic endpoints
